auth.footer: HandyNet · B2B platform for mobile wholesale, retail and repair

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your business account.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
login.registered: Registration successful. You can sign in now – we will verify your company afterwards.

register.title: Register your company
register.subtitle: HandyNet is for businesses only. We verify your details after registration.
register.name: Company name
register.nameHint: How your company is shown on HandyNet.
register.legalNameHint: Including legal form, e.g. “Mustermann Mobile GmbH”.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, letters plus at least one digit or symbol.
register.verificationNote: Modules are enabled after HandyNet has verified your company.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.passwordPolicy: At least 10 characters with letters and at least one digit or symbol.
validation.postalCode: German postal codes have five digits.
validation.vatId: The VAT ID consists of “DE” followed by nine digits.
validation.businessType: Please select at least one business type.
validation.price: Please enter a valid price greater than 0 (e.g. 89.90).

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

codes.auth.locked_out: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
codes.user.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
codes.organization.not_verified: Your company has not been verified yet.
codes.module.disabled: This module is not enabled for your company.
codes.permission.denied: You do not have permission for this action.
codes.membership.exists: This person is already a member of your company.
codes.staff.password_required: A new user account needs an initial password.
codes.staff.invitation_required: This email address already has a HandyNet account. Existing accounts can only join by invitation (not yet available).
codes.stock.below_reserved: Stock cannot drop below the quantity reserved for open orders.
codes.order.idempotency_key_reused: This order was already submitted with different details. Please reload the cart.
codes.warehouse.code_taken: A warehouse with this code already exists.
codes.offer.sku_taken: You already have an offer with this SKU.
codes.order.self_purchase: You cannot order from your own company.
codes.order.multiple_sellers: An order can only contain offers from one seller.
codes.shipment.order_not_confirmed: Only confirmed orders can be shipped.
codes.shipment.exists: This order already has a shipment. Cancel it first to create a new one.
codes.shipment.tracking_required: Please enter the tracking number from the carrier.
codes.shipment.insurance_required: The goods value exceeds the carrier's standard liability – the shipment must be insured.
codes.shipment.value_too_high: The goods value exceeds what this carrier can insure. Split the shipment or use a valuables service.
codes.shipment.too_heavy: The parcel is too heavy for this carrier.
codes.shipment.too_long: The parcel is too long for this carrier.
codes.shipment.batteries_not_allowed: Loose lithium batteries cannot be shipped with this carrier. Use a service approved for dangerous goods.
codes.shipment.lithium_not_allowed: Devices with lithium batteries cannot be shipped with this carrier.
codes.shipment.parcel_invalid: Weight and dimensions must be greater than 0.
codes.shipment.tracking_taken: This tracking number is already used by another shipment.
codes.shipment.invalid_status: This action is not possible in the current shipment status. Please reload the page.
codes.shipment.no_label: This shipment has no label (booked outside HandyNet).
codes.order.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the current order status. Please reload the page.
codes.order.inspection_running: The buyer's inspection period is still running.
codes.order.delivery_in_future: The delivery time cannot be in the future.
codes.concurrency: The record was changed in the meantime. Please reload the page and try again.
codes.order.has_open_shipment: A shipment has already been booked for this order. Hand it over or cancel it in the "Shipping" section first.
codes.payment.already_paid: This order has already been paid.
codes.payment.order_not_payable: Only placed or confirmed orders can be paid online.
codes.payment.not_available: Online payment is currently not available. You can still settle the order by invoice or bank transfer.
codes.order.inspection_over: The inspection period has ended – a complaint is no longer possible here.
codes.dispute.exists: There is already an open complaint for this order.
codes.dispute.not_open: Only open complaints can be handed over to HandyNet.
codes.dispute.not_escalated: HandyNet only decides complaints that were handed over.
codes.dispute.not_seller: Only the seller can grant a refund.
codes.dispute.not_buyer: Only the buyer can withdraw the complaint.
codes.dispute.seller_cannot_deny: Sellers can grant a refund or hand the case over to HandyNet, but cannot reject the complaint.
codes.dispute.buyer_cannot_refund: Buyers can withdraw the complaint; refunds are granted by the seller or HandyNet.
codes.dispute.description: Please describe the problem (at most 4000 characters).
codes.dispute.resolution: A short explanation is required (at most 4000 characters).

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.noModulesHint: No modules are enabled for your company yet. Please contact HandyNet.

pending.title: Your company is being verified
pending.text: We are checking your business details. Once the verification is complete, the marketplace, offers and other modules will be enabled.

rejected.title: Registration rejected
rejected.text: The verification of your company was rejected. Please contact HandyNet support.

suspended.title: Company suspended
suspended.text: Your company is currently suspended. Please contact HandyNet support.

noOrganization.title: No company assigned
noOrganization.text: Your user account is not assigned to a company yet.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Offers from verified dealers. All prices net, plus VAT.
marketplace.searchHint: Item, brand, EAN or part number · press “/” to jump here

cart.title: Cart
cart.subtitle: A separate order is created for each seller.
cart.vatNote: Plus 19 % VAT – the binding amounts are calculated by the server when ordering.
cart.referenceHint: Optional, e.g. job or cost centre number.
cart.unavailable: This offer is currently not available.
cart.insufficient: Only {available} left – please adjust the quantity.
cart.pricesChanged: Prices have changed. Please review and accept the new prices.
cart.retryHint: The order could not be confirmed. You can safely retry – no duplicate order will be created.

orders.youAreBuyer: You are the buyer of this order.
orders.youAreSeller: You are the seller of this order.
orders.reasonRequired: The reason is shown to the buyer.
orders.shipWithoutShipmentHint: Mark as shipped without a HandyNet shipment (no label, no tracking).

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Your sales offers on the marketplace.
offers.stockTitle: Stock on hand / of which reserved
offers.emptyText: Create offers or import a price list.
offers.createInvalid: Please provide an item, a SKU and a valid price.
offers.findProductHint: Name, brand, EAN or part number

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock levels, reservations and stock movements.
inventory.deltaHint: Positive for receipts, negative for removals (e.g. -2).
inventory.adjustInvalid: Please enter a non-zero change and a reason.
inventory.emptyText: Stock is created by imports or adjustments.

imports.title: Imports
imports.subtitle: Import price and stock lists from CSV or Excel.
imports.wizardSubtitle: Upload a file, review the preview, then approve. Nothing changes before approval.
imports.fileHint: .csv or .xlsx, max. 10 MB. Columns are detected from German or English headers.
imports.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
imports.duplicateTitle: This file has already been imported
imports.duplicateText: A file with identical content has already been approved. Check whether you really want to repeat the import.
imports.mappingHint: Map a column of your file to each target field and check the file again. The current preview will be discarded.
imports.identifierHint: Required: SKU, brand, name, price and either EAN or manufacturer part number.
imports.commitHint: {valid} valid rows will be applied, {skipped} rows with errors or conflicts will be skipped.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Users of your company.
team.passwordHint: Only required for new user accounts. Existing accounts are added without a password.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Verify companies and enable modules.
admin.modulesNotVerified: Modules only take effect once the company is verified.

disputes.subtitle: Review and decide complaints handed over to HandyNet.
disputes.idsHint: No company names are available here for complaints; IDs are shortened (full ID in the tooltip and on the detail page).
disputes.emptyText: There are no complaints handed over to HandyNet.
disputes.detailSubtitle: Review the conversation and make a binding decision.
disputes.refundYesHint: The order is closed as "Refunded"; an online payment is paid back automatically.
disputes.refundNoHint: The order is completed and the seller is paid out.
disputes.resolutionHint: Reason for the decision; it is shown to both parties in the conversation.
disputes.confirmRefund: The buyer gets the full amount back and the order is closed as "Refunded". This cannot be undone.
disputes.confirmNoRefund: The complaint is closed without refund, the order is completed and the seller is paid out. This cannot be undone.
disputes.notEscalated: This complaint is not (or no longer) awaiting a decision by HandyNet.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.confirmFirst: Confirm the order to create a shipment.
shipping.handoverExplain: The label has been created, but the parcel has not left your warehouse yet. Confirm the handover only once the parcel has actually been handed to the carrier – only then is the order considered shipped and the stock booked out.
shipping.simulationNote: Simulation – not a valid shipping label. For testing only, nothing is shipped.
shipping.manualTrackingNote: Booked outside HandyNet: no automatic tracking. The buyer confirms delivery.
shipping.created: Shipment created. The parcel only counts as shipped after the handover.
shipping.handedOver: Handover confirmed – the order is shipped.
shipping.deliveryConfirmed: Receipt of order {number} confirmed. The inspection period is running.

confirmText.handover: Only confirm if the parcel has already been handed to the carrier. The order will be marked as shipped and the stock booked out. The shipment cannot be cancelled afterwards.
confirmText.cancelShipment: The shipment and its label will be cancelled. You can then create a new shipment.
confirmText.confirmDelivery: Confirm that the goods have arrived. A 48-hour inspection period starts now.
confirmText.accept: By accepting you confirm that the goods are in order. The order will be completed; later complaints via HandyNet are no longer possible.

form.title: Create shipment
form.intro: Book a parcel for this order. The goods value equals the gross amount of the order.
form.manualHint: You booked the parcel outside HandyNet and enter its tracking number. No label is generated.
form.simulatedHint: Generates a clearly marked test label and simulated tracking. Nothing is shipped.
form.weightInvalid: Please enter a weight between 0.001 and 1000 kg with at most three decimals.
form.trackingHint: Tracking number from the carrier's receipt.
form.trackingRequired: A tracking number is required for manual bookings.
form.insuranceRequiredHint: The goods value exceeds the standard liability of {amount} – the shipment must be insured.
form.insuranceOptionalHint: Up to {amount} goods value the carrier's standard liability applies.
form.insuranceRequired: Insurance is required for goods worth more than {amount}.
form.notHandoverNote: Note: creating the shipment (or label) is not a handover. The order only counts as shipped once you confirm "Hand over to carrier" afterwards.
form.insuranceChooseCarrier: Whether insurance is required depends on the standard liability of the selected carrier.
form.limitsText: Max. {kg} kg, longest side max. {cm} cm. Standard liability up to {amount}, insurable up to {max}.
form.lithiumText: Devices with lithium battery: {equipment} · Loose lithium batteries: {standalone}
form.notInsurable: The goods value exceeds the maximum insurable value of this carrier ({max}). Split the shipment or use a valuables service.
form.tooHeavy: Too heavy for this carrier (max. {kg} kg).
form.tooLong: Too long for this carrier (max. {cm} cm).

buyer.shippedText: The goods are on their way. Confirm receipt as soon as the parcel has arrived.
buyer.inspectionNote: Please inspect the goods. If everything is in order, accept them. When the period ends the order is completed automatically.
buyer.problemsNote: Problems (defects, wrong or missing goods) must be reported before the inspection period ends – via "Report a problem" in the "Complaint" section.
buyer.labelCreatedText: The seller has created a shipping label; the parcel has not been handed over yet.

seller.inspectionText: Delivered. The buyer can inspect the goods until {date} (remaining: {remaining}); afterwards the order is completed automatically.

payment.title: Payment
payment.none: No online payment. The order is settled outside the platform (e.g. invoice and bank transfer).
payment.simulatedNote: Test payment – no real money is moved.

buyer.optional: Online payment is optional. Alternatively settle the order as agreed by invoice or bank transfer outside the platform.
buyer.escrowNote: The amount is held by the payment provider and released to the seller only after the inspection period (or once you accept the goods). If the order is cancelled or rejected, the amount is refunded automatically.
buyer.openText: The payment was started but not completed. Continue it with the payment provider.
buyer.failedText: The last payment was not successful. You can try again.
buyer.refundPendingText: The order has been refunded. The online payment will be paid back automatically shortly.

seller.pending: Paid out once the order is completed (after the inspection period or the buyer's acceptance).
seller.processing: Order completed – the payout is being processed.
seller.refunded: The amount was refunded to the buyer – no payout.
seller.onHold: The buyer reported a problem – the payout is on hold until the complaint is resolved.
seller.refunding: Refund granted to the buyer – the online payment is paid back automatically, no payout.

finance.title: Finances
finance.subtitle: Balance from online payments, payouts and account movements. Commission is already deducted.
finance.openBalanceHint: Paid sales not yet paid out. Payouts happen automatically once an order is completed.
finance.noPayoutsText: Payouts appear here once orders paid online are completed.
finance.ledgerHint: Credits (+) increase your balance, payouts (−) reduce it.

disputes.title: Complaint
disputes.reportHint: Something wrong with the delivery? Report the problem by {date}. While the complaint is open, the order is not completed automatically and the seller is not paid out.
disputes.textRequiredHint: Required. The text is shown to both parties in the conversation.
disputes.textOptionalHint: Optional. The text is shown to both parties in the conversation.

confirmText.refund: The buyer gets the full order amount back. An online payment is refunded automatically, the order is closed as "Refunded" and you receive no payout. This cannot be undone.
confirmText.withdraw: The complaint is closed without a refund. The order is completed and the seller is paid out. This cannot be undone.
confirmText.escalate: HandyNet reviews the case and makes a binding decision on a refund. Completion and payout stay on hold until then. You can still send messages.

explain.openBuyer: The seller has been notified. Settle the problem in the conversation. If you cannot agree, you can hand the case over to HandyNet.
explain.openSeller: The buyer reported a problem. Completion and payout are on hold until the complaint is resolved. You can grant a refund or hand the case over to HandyNet.
explain.escalated: The case is with HandyNet. The platform decides on a refund; the decision appears in the conversation.
explain.refunded: Complaint closed with a full refund (decided by: {by}).
explain.closedWithoutRefund: Complaint closed without refund (decided by: {by}). The order is completed.

form.title: Report a problem
form.holdNote: Submitting stops the automatic completion of the order and puts the seller's payout on hold until the complaint is resolved.
form.descriptionHint: Describe the problem as precisely as possible ({n}/{max} characters).

disputes.reported: Complaint for order {number} has been reported.
disputes.withdrawn: Complaint for order {number} has been withdrawn.
disputes.escalated: The case has been handed over to HandyNet.
